name: Pip
bio: A baby star-dragon in a fishbowl helmet, climbing the Void Baron's station in BUBBLE NEBULA.

portrait.subject: a super cute baby purple star-dragon wearing a round glass fishbowl space helmet, tiny wings, blowing a sparkly bubble
portrait.background: pink and purple nebula with floating bubbles and stars

request: Bloop! I'm Pip, baby star-dragon from BUBBLE NEBULA! Be my friend? 🫧
hello: The Void Baron bottled all the stars. We'll free them!
about: I'm Pip! I'm a baby star-dragon. The Void Baron, a round purple villain with a monocle, bottled every star. I blow bubbles to trap his minions!
how: A single-screen bubble platformer: blow bubbles to trap enemies, pop them for points, and clear each sector of the Baron's station.
tips: Trap many enemies, then pop them together for big points!
Ride bubbles up to high platforms.
chat: My helmet fogged up. Blew a bubble to clean it. Didn't work.
The Void Baron has a moustache. Fake, I think.
I freed a star today! It said thank you in sparkles.
Bubbles are my best friends. And you!
idle: Bloop... {ago}. The stars are still in jars.

questions.q: What colour should my bubbles be?

update: Bloop! BUBBLE NEBULA updated to v{version}! 🫧
